test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Total Revenue Curve of a firm shows the relationship between the _________ made by the firm and the output level of the firm.
solution:
The correct answer is __**total revenue.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

**Total Revenue:**

__
 
• While a firm in a perfectly competitive market does not influence its price, it does determine the output it will produce.
 
• In selecting the quantity of that output, one important consideration is the revenue the firm will gain by producing it.
 
• A firm’s total revenue is found by multiplying its output by the price at which it sells that output. 
 
• Total revenue (TR) is the total receipts a seller can obtain from selling goods or services to buyers.
 
• It can be written as P × Q, which is the price of the goods multiplied by the firm’s output.
 
• **Total revenue = TR = P × Q**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
 

 Average Revenue
 It is referred to as the revenue that is earned per unit of output. In other words, it is the revenue that is obtained by the seller on selling each unit of the commodity. The average revenue of a business is obtained by dividing the total revenue by the total output.
 
 

 Marginal revenue
 It is the increase in revenue that results from the sale of one additional unit of output. While marginal revenue can remain constant over a certain level of output, it follows from the law of diminishing returns and will eventually slow down as the output level increases.
